# Data Source: stripe_radar_value_list

A list of values that Radar rules refer to by `alias`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_radar_value_list" "blocked_emails" {
  alias = "blocked_emails"
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

Exactly one must be set.

* `alias` - (Optional) The name of the value list for use in rules. Stripe stores it in lower case, so it must be written in lower case.
* `id` - (Optional) The ID of the radar value list to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `created_by` - The name or email address of the user who created this value list.
* `item_type` - Type of the items in the value list. One of `card_fingerprint`, `card_bin`, `crypto_fingerprint`, `email`, `ip_address`, `country`, `string`, `case_sensitive_string`, `customer_id`, `account`, `sepa_debit_fingerprint`, or `us_bank_account_fingerprint`. Use `string` if the item type is unknown or mixed. Possible values: `account`, `card_bin`, `card_fingerprint`, `case_sensitive_string`, `country`, `crypto_fingerprint`, `customer_id`, `email`, `ip_address`, `sepa_debit_fingerprint`, `string`, `us_bank_account_fingerprint`.
* `list_items` - List of items contained within this value list. See [`list_items`](#list_items) below.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `metadata` - Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.
* `name` - The human-readable name of the value list.

<a id="list_items"></a>
### `list_items`

The `list_items` attribute supports:

* `data` - Details about each object. See [`list_items.data`](#list_items.data) below.
* `has_more` - True if this list has another page of items after this one that can be fetched.
* `object` - String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Always has the value `list`. Possible values: `list`.
* `url` - The URL where this list can be accessed.

<a id="list_items.data"></a>
### `list_items.data`

The `list_items.data` attribute is a list. Each element supports:

* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `created_by` - The name or email address of the user who added this item to the value list.
* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `object` - String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Possible values: `radar.value_list_item`.
* `value` - The value of the item.
* `value_list` - The identifier of the value list this item belongs to.
